atlas_120_viruses_note: Carrier release for the HuProt 4.0 pair only. It holds the viral_nonhuman subset of canonical_exposure under its own antigen ids, so offering it as a library of its own would imply an independent surface. Its tables are published; the selector is deferred until the pairing can be offered as canonical_exposure pinned to that scope.
